evals.prompt: Version a traced support agent with MLflow so every trace resolves to its Git commit, prompt version, provider model, retriever index, and generation config. Include a safe fallback for Databricks Git Folders.
evals.expected_output: A feature-gated LoggedModel and active-model workflow with immutable source/config identities, trace linkage, no secret leakage, and a Databricks-compatible fallback.

evals.prompt: Compare two MLflow application versions on the same evaluation dataset, explain which evidence should gate promotion, and show how production failures become regression cases.
evals.expected_output: A fair traced comparison using mlflow.genai.evaluate, fixed scorers/data, slice-level gates, lineage, and a closed trace-to-dataset loop.

evals.prompt: Explain why moving a Unity Catalog model alias is not the same as deploying a new Databricks serving endpoint version, then propose an auditable release record.
evals.expected_output: A precise separation of LoggedModel, registered version/alias, served entity, endpoint config, traffic route, readiness state, and deployment evidence.
